subject: Short-burst quota injection request — 12h real-world latency verification
messages:
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan@avaretail.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Short-burst quota injection request — 12h run

Hey Sean,

Quick ask from our ops team: we're planning a 12-hour, real-world latency validation on our checkout ML path next Wednesday and want to use Redwood for the endpoint. This isn't a sustained POC — it's a sharp, 12-hour window to validate p95 and tail latency under production-like traffic. High level:~
- Target sustained concurrency: ~650 RPS (spiky patterns, 10% bursts to 1.2k for short windows)
- Expected total tokens: ~1.2M tokens during the window
- Goal: confirm p95 < 220ms and identify any KV-cache warmup behaviors

We currently have the trial allocation but it's insufficient for a single contiguous run. Can Redwood provide a short-burst quota injection (trial top-up / promo credits) to run this 12-hour verification? We can share a brief run-plan and post-run telemetry requirements.

Attached is a small CSV with the planned traffic mix (avaretail-load-plan.csv). If you need approvals or a quick SOC checklist, let me know — we can expedite.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Ops Manager, Ava Retail
ops@avaretail.com


From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan@avaretail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-burst quota injection request — 12h run

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the CSV. We can usually support a one-off short-burst top-up for a POC like this, but I need to confirm the amount with the promo/finance owners and confirm any export/security info they need. Two quick questions that will speed approvals:

1) Is this hitting a hosted Redwood model (hosted API) or a Dedicated endpoint pinned to a specific model variant?
2) Will any of the traffic include PII-sensitive payloads? If yes, we'll need the security checklist signed and a short data-flow diagram.

If it's hosted and non-PII, I can get a provisional promo top-up approved for up to ~$1,200 in equivalent credits (roughly the token limit you requested) pending sign-off from our promotions manager. Karthik / Neha — can you weigh in on recommended amount for a 12-hour 650 RPS spiky run and flag if we need any docs from Ava Retail?

If folks approve, Jordan: I'll coordinate the delivery window and we can set a 15-min check-in right before the run.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Matthews <jordan@avaretail.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-burst quota injection request — 12h run

Sean / Neha — reviewed the CSV and traffic profile. Quick calc: 650 RPS sustained over 12 hours with spikes will land around 1.0–1.4M tokens depending on prompt lengths. For safety I'd recommend allocating a 25% buffer. My ask: provision a promo credit package equivalent to 1.5M tokens (~$1,350 equivalent at current promo rates) with the following controls:
- Window: 12 hours (with a 30-min pre-check and a 1-hr tail for telemetry)
- Model: hosted gpt-like open-vendor variant (Jordan — confirm model; if they want a quantized/private variant we'll need a different SKU)
- Rate limits: we set a per-minute cap to avoid accidental sustained overrun; team to share runbook with Karthik before start

Attachments: quick mutual action checklist and runbook template (internal reference).

If finance/promo approve ~1.5M tokens, Jordan — we can schedule the run and I'll coordinate the throttles.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Promo credit: equivalent to 1.5M tokens (internal code: PROMO-AVR-2025Q3)
- Window: 12 hours on 2025-07-16 22:00 - 2025-07-17 10:00 UTC (Jordan pls confirm)
- Controls: per-minute cap set to ~80k tokens/min, auto cutover to lower-tier model if thresholds exceeded
- Attachments: promo-grant-2025Q3.pdf (approval memo & usage conditions)

Jordan — please confirm the exact model name and whether payloads will include any PII. If non-PII and hosted, we can proceed. If PII present, we need signed SOC checklist (I attached the promo memo that includes the compliance checkbox). Once Jordan confirms, Sean / Karthik please coordinate activation and give Avaretail a 15-min pre-run handshake.
